topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's core themes regarding cancer evolution and outlines the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how genetic mutations, Darwinian selection, and epigenetic alterations drive clonal fitness and tumor initiation.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchy and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the cancer stem cell hypothesis and experimental evidence regarding the cell of origin in tumor development.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze how external promoters, chronic inflammation, and stromal interactions create permissive conditions for tumor outgrowth.

topics.label: Methods for investigating tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the experimental and computational technologies used to map and analyze tumor evolution and cell interactions.

topics.label: Multifactorial synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the interplay among mutational burden, cell of origin, epigenetic plasticity, and microenvironmental conditions in driving cancer progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of next session
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the formal closing remarks for the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
